title: Orthogonal complement of a binary subspace
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb{N}$ and let $A$ be a linear subspace of $(\mathbb{F}_2)^n$. Its perpendicular subspace consists of the vectors whose dot product with every vector in $A$ is zero.
